name: navigator-scan-permission-decision
body: The distributed `codebase-navigator` prompt carries `apg_scan: ask` as its scan authorization; opencode prompts per call and the user may choose always allow. The permission layer is the scan gate, and the prompt holds zero bespoke consent ritual. `requirements.requirement.navigator-scan-permission` drives `domain.entity.scan-authorization`, which is realised by `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` (`implemented-by` `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`) and `solution.component.navigator-scan-permission-coherence-test` (`implemented-by` the existing test `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose`). The law `requirements.constraint.scan-consent-via-permission` governs this delegation.
